name: The Gate Warden
lore: A stone-armoured giant bound to the castle gate. Its power, once taken, lets the bearer leap.
look: A giant in a deep hood whose face is lost in shadow, two embers for eyes; hammered iron harness with a fur mantle, a tattered red tabard and shroud, a two-handed maul.

avatar.note: Built with the character kit (actors/bosses/10b-warden-avatar.js). scale is the size in the world (the hero is 1). Gear ids are in content/character/gear.json.
